description_en: Creates a custom code or image agent in a specified workspace, supports code package, ACR image, and custom image deployments, and executes the deployment asynchronously
description_zh: 在指定工作空间创建自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent，支持代码包、ACR 镜像和自定义镜像部署，并异步执行部署
name: CreateCustomAgent

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the custom code or image agent belongs
parameters.help_zh: 自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent所属的工作空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

fields.help_en: The inbound access method
fields.help_zh: 入站访问方式
fields.name: access_mode

fields.help_en: The user access scope
fields.help_zh: 用户访问范围
fields.name: access_scope

fields.help_en: The absolute mount path in the container, such as /data/train. Mount targets cannot be duplicated or form parent-child overrides, and must avoid platform reserved directories
fields.help_zh: 容器内的绝对挂载路径，例如 /data/train；挂载目标不得重复或形成父子覆盖，并须避开平台保留目录
fields.name: mount_path

fields.help_en: The existing non-empty relative directory under the access point. This parameter is required for each mount item. Root directories, absolute paths, and parent directory traversals are not allowed
fields.help_zh: AccessPoint 下已存在的非空相对目录，每个挂载项必填。不允许根目录、绝对路径或上级目录跳转
fields.name: path

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the mount is read-only. A value of true indicates read-only, and a value of false indicates read and write. If omitted, the default value is false
fields.help_zh: 是否只读挂载。true 表示只读，false 表示可读写；省略时默认为 false
fields.name: read_only

fields.help_en: The access point domain name. This parameter is required for each mount item. Use the DomainName from the NAS ListAccessPoints response. Do not include protocols, ports, or paths
fields.help_zh: AccessPoint 域名，每个挂载项必填。取 NAS ListAccessPoints 响应中的 DomainName，不含协议、端口或路径
fields.name: server

fields.help_en: The NAS storage mount configuration. Currently, only the AgenticFS type is supported, which is used to mount file directories in access points to agent runtime instances. This is a list of AgenticFS directory mounts. The total number of items in this list and ossMounts cannot exceed 10. If omitted or set to [] during creation, no mounts are configured. If omitted during an update, the existing configuration is retained. If set to [], the mounts are cleared. Null is not accepted
fields.help_zh: NAS 存储挂载配置，当前支持 AgenticFS 类型，用于把接入点中的文件目录挂载到 Agent 运行实例。 AgenticFS 目录挂载列表，与 ossMounts 合计最多 10 项；创建时省略或 [] 表示无挂载，更新时省略保留、[] 清空，不接受 null
fields.name: agentic_fs_mounts

fields.help_en: The startup command for the code package. This parameter is required in code package mode. The working directory is the root directory of the decompressed code, /code, such as python main.py. Quotes and escapes are supported. Environment variables, pipelines, and logical operations are not automatically expanded. For complex commands, use a script in the package
fields.help_zh: 代码包启动命令，代码包模式必填。工作目录为解压后的代码根目录 /code，例如 python main.py。支持引号和转义，不自动展开环境变量、管道或逻辑运算；复杂命令请使用包内脚本
fields.name: entrypoint

fields.help_en: The code runtime environment identifier, such as python3.12. When creating or switching environments, use the identifier returned by ListAgentCodeRuntimes. The identifier is verified by the current version catalog and is not a fixed enumeration
fields.help_zh: 代码运行环境标识，例如 python3.12。创建或切换环境时使用 ListAgentCodeRuntimes 返回的标识，由当前版本目录校验，不是固定枚举
fields.name: language_runtime

fields.help_en: The source URL of the code package. Supports oss:// URLs or HTTPS object URLs of standard OSS public domain names, including OSS signed URLs. Arbitrary external sites, custom domain names, or additional authentication request headers are not supported. After a local upload, use the sourceUri returned by GetAgentCodePackageUploadUrl. The URL is re-verified and transferred during creation or update. After being saved, a fixed oss:// URL of the platform is returned. You can reuse this fixed URL for regular updates
fields.help_zh: 代码包来源地址。支持 oss:// 地址或标准 OSS 公网域名的 HTTPS 对象地址（含 OSS 签名链接）；不支持任意外部站点、自定义域名或额外认证请求头。本地上传后使用 GetAgentCodePackageUploadUrl 返回的 sourceUri。创建或更新时重新校验并转存，保存后返回平台固定 oss:// 地址；普通更新可复用该固定地址
fields.name: source_uri

fields.help_en: The code package deployment configuration. This parameter is mutually exclusive with container. You must specify sourceUri, languageRuntime, and entrypoint, and set artifact.port. ZIP and TAR.GZ formats are supported. Dependencies must be provided by the caller in the package
fields.help_zh: 代码包部署配置，与 container 互斥。须同时提供 sourceUri、languageRuntime、entrypoint，并填写 artifact.port；支持 ZIP 或 TAR.GZ，依赖由调用方随包提供
fields.name: code

fields.help_en: The optional image startup command. If specified, it must be a non-empty string. If omitted, the default startup method of the image is used
fields.help_zh: 可选的镜像启动命令。指定时必须为非空字符串；省略时使用镜像的默认启动方式
fields.name: entrypoint

fields.help_en: The ID of the ACR instance to which the image repository belongs. This parameter cannot be empty
fields.help_zh: 镜像仓库所属的 ACR 实例 ID，不能为空
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The namespace to which the ACR image repository belongs. This parameter cannot be empty
fields.help_zh: ACR 镜像仓库所属的命名空间，不能为空
fields.name: namespace

fields.help_en: The name of the image repository in the ACR namespace. This parameter cannot be empty
fields.help_zh: ACR 命名空间中的镜像仓库名称，不能为空
fields.name: repo

fields.help_en: The image tag used for deployment. This parameter cannot be empty. When updating the tag, you must also specify artifact.port and other required image fields
fields.help_zh: 部署使用的镜像标签，不能为空。更新标签时，须同时提供 artifact.port 和其他必需的镜像字段
fields.name: tag

fields.help_en: The image source type. A value of acr indicates an ACR image, and a value of custom indicates a custom image source. For the corresponding source configurations, refer to the descriptions of artifact.container and customImage
fields.help_zh: 镜像来源类型：acr 表示 ACR 镜像，custom 表示自定义镜像来源；相应来源配置见 artifact.container 与 customImage 的说明
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The container image deployment configuration. This parameter is mutually exclusive with code. For ACR sources, specify type=acr, instanceId, namespace, repo, and tag. For custom sources, specify type=custom and submit the complete customImage
fields.help_zh: 容器镜像部署配置，与 code 互斥。ACR 来源填写 type=acr、instanceId、namespace、repo、tag；自定义来源填写 type=custom，并提交完整 customImage
fields.name: container

fields.help_en: The TCP port listened by the agent service. Valid values: 1 to 65535
fields.help_zh: 智能体服务监听的 TCP 端口，取值为 1～65535
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The deployment artifact configuration. You must specify the service listening port in port and select either code or container as the deployment method
fields.help_zh: 部署制品配置。须填写服务监听端口 port，并在 code 与 container 中选择一种部署方式
fields.name: artifact

fields.help_en: The custom image address. This parameter is required and verified by the backend when customImage is submitted. Specify the complete registry[:port]/repository:tag or registry[:port]/repository@sha256:digest. Multi-level paths are supported. Do not include protocols or user information
fields.help_zh: 提交 customImage 时必填，由后端校验；完整 registry[:port]/repository:tag 或 registry[:port]/repository@sha256:digest，支持多级路径，不带协议或用户信息
fields.name: image

fields.help_en: The repository password or token for this submission
fields.help_zh: 本次仓库密码或 Token
fields.name: password

fields.help_en: The security group ID. This parameter is required when type is set to vpc, and must belong to the selected VPC
fields.help_zh: type=vpc 时必填，须属于所选 VPC
fields.name: security_group_id

fields.help_en: The pull network type. This parameter is required and verified by the backend when pullNetwork is submitted. The default value for new creations is public, which is independent of the agent runtime network
fields.help_zh: 提交 pullNetwork 时必填，由后端校验；新建默认公网，与 Agent 运行网络独立
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The security group ID. This parameter is required when type is set to vpc, and must belong to the selected VPC
fields.help_zh: type=vpc 时必填，须属于所选 VPC
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en: The VPC ID. This parameter is required when type is set to vpc. The associated account and region are verified by the backend
fields.help_zh: type=vpc 时必填，所属账号和地域由后端校验
fields.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en: The independent pull network configuration. This parameter is required and verified by the backend when customImage is submitted. For Internet access, only pass type=public
fields.help_zh: 提交 customImage 时必填，由后端校验；完整独立拉取网络配置，公网只传 type=public
fields.name: pull_network

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to skip HTTPS certificate verification
fields.help_zh: 跳过 HTTPS 证书校验
fields.name: skip_tls_verify

fields.help_en: The repository username for this submission
fields.help_zh: 本次仓库用户名
fields.name: username

fields.help_en: The custom image source. This parameter is required when artifact.container.type is set to custom, and omitted for other sources
fields.help_zh: 自定义镜像来源；artifact.container.type=custom 时必填，其他来源省略
fields.name: custom_image

fields.example: 提供对话服务的自定义智能体
fields.help_en: The description of the agent purpose. The maximum length is 1024 characters after leading and trailing whitespaces are removed
fields.help_zh: 智能体的用途说明，去除首尾空白后最多 1024 个字符
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The name of the environment variable. It cannot be empty and must be unique within the current list of environment variables
fields.help_zh: 环境变量名称，不能为空，且在本次环境变量列表中不得重复
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The value of the environment variable. It must be a string. Empty strings are allowed
fields.help_zh: 环境变量值，必须为字符串，允许空字符串
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The list of environment variables. Each item contains a name and a value. The entire list is replaced during an update
fields.help_zh: 环境变量列表，每项包含名称和值。更新时整体替换该列表
fields.name: variables

fields.help_en: The environment variable configurations passed to the agent runtime process
fields.help_zh: 传递给智能体运行进程的环境变量配置
fields.name: environment

fields.help_en: This parameter is currently invalid. Omit this parameter
fields.help_zh: 此参数当前不生效，请省略
fields.name: healthy_threshold

fields.help_en: The interval between two health checks, in seconds. It must be a positive integer. Default value: 10
fields.help_zh: 两次健康检查的间隔，单位为秒，必须为正整数，省略时默认为 10
fields.name: interval_seconds

fields.help_en: The HTTP health check path. It must start with a forward slash (/). Default value: /healthz
fields.help_zh: HTTP 健康检查路径，必须以 / 开头，省略时默认为 /healthz
fields.name: path

fields.help_en: The port accessed by the health check. This field is required when you configure a health check. Valid values: 1 to 65535
fields.help_zh: 健康检查访问的端口，配置健康检查时必须填写，取值为 1～65535
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The timeout period for a single health check, in seconds. It must be a positive integer and less than the value of intervalSeconds. Default value: 2
fields.help_zh: 单次健康检查的超时秒数，必须为正整数且小于 intervalSeconds，省略时默认为 2
fields.name: timeout_seconds

fields.help_en: The number of consecutive health check failures required to mark the instance as unhealthy. It must be a positive integer. Default value: 3
fields.help_zh: 连续健康检查失败达到该次数后判定不健康，必须为正整数，省略时默认为 3
fields.name: unhealthy_threshold

fields.help_en: The optional HTTP health check configuration. If this object is provided, the port field is required. Unspecified fields use default values. If omitted during creation, no health check is configured. If this top-level field is omitted during an update, the original configuration is retained. Pass null to remove the health check
fields.help_zh: 可选的 HTTP 健康检查配置。提供该对象时必须填写 port，未指定的其他项使用默认值。创建时省略表示不配置；更新时省略该顶层字段保留原配置，传 null 移除健康检查
fields.name: health_check

fields.help_en: The name of the SLS Logstore that receives agent logs
fields.help_zh: 接收智能体日志的 SLS Logstore 名称
fields.name: logstore

fields.help_en: The name of the SLS project that receives agent logs
fields.help_zh: 接收智能体日志的 SLS Project 名称
fields.name: project

fields.help_en: The SLS log delivery destination. When you configure this object, neither the project nor the logstore field can be empty
fields.help_zh: SLS 日志投递目标。配置该对象时，project 和 logstore 均不能为空
fields.name: sls

fields.help_en: The log delivery configuration for the agent. You can specify the Simple Log Service (SLS) project and Logstore. After a successful creation or update, verify that logs are delivered as expected
fields.help_zh: 智能体日志投递配置，可指定日志服务 SLS 的 Project 和 Logstore。创建或更新成功后，请确认日志是否正常投递
fields.name: logging

fields.help_en: The name of the custom code or image agent. The length must be 1 to 128 characters after leading and trailing whitespaces are removed. The name must be unique within the same workspace
fields.help_zh: 自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent名称，去除首尾空白后长度为 1～128 个字符，同一工作空间内不可重名
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow the agent to access the Internet. A Boolean value is required when you configure accessInternet. For this setting to take effect, the workspace must also allow Internet access
fields.help_zh: 是否允许智能体访问互联网。配置 accessInternet 时必须提供布尔值；实际生效还需工作空间允许互联网访问
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The Internet access configuration. If this access item is omitted, Internet access is not restricted on the agent side. However, the workspace must still allow Internet access
fields.help_zh: 互联网访问配置。省略该访问项时，智能体侧不限制互联网访问；仍需工作空间允许互联网访问
fields.name: access_internet

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow the agent to access the user VPC configured for the workspace. A Boolean value is required when you configure accessVpc. For this setting to take effect, the workspace must also allow VPC access
fields.help_zh: 是否允许智能体访问工作空间配置的用户 VPC。配置 accessVpc 时必须提供布尔值；实际生效还需工作空间允许 VPC 访问
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The user VPC access configuration. If this access item is omitted, VPC access is not restricted on the agent side. However, the workspace must still be configured to allow access to the user VPC
fields.help_zh: 用户 VPC 访问配置。省略该访问项时，智能体侧不限制 VPC 访问；仍需工作空间配置并允许访问用户 VPC
fields.name: access_vpc

fields.help_en: The network access configuration for the agent. If this object is provided, omitted access items are treated as allowed. The actual accessible scope is still restricted by the workspace network configuration. To retain the original restrictions during an update, specify both accessInternet and accessVpc
fields.help_zh: 智能体的网络访问配置。提供该对象时，省略的访问项按允许处理；实际可访问范围仍受工作空间网络配置限制。更新时若需保留原限制，请同时填写 accessInternet 和 accessVpc
fields.name: network

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable agent observability
fields.help_zh: 启用 Agent 观测
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The observability configuration for the high-code agent
fields.help_zh: 高代码 Agent 观测配置
fields.name: observability

fields.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket. This field is required for each mount item. The length must be 3 to 63 characters. It can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, and cannot start or end with a hyphen
fields.help_zh: OSS Bucket 名称，每个挂载项必填。长度为 3～63 个字符，仅包含小写字母、数字和短横线，不能以短横线开头或结尾
fields.name: bucket_name

fields.help_en: The absolute mount path in the container, such as /data/train. Mount targets cannot be duplicated or form parent-child overrides, and must avoid platform reserved directories
fields.help_zh: 容器内的绝对挂载路径，例如 /data/train；挂载目标不得重复或形成父子覆盖，并须避开平台保留目录
fields.name: mount_path

fields.help_en: The non-empty relative object directory prefix in the bucket. This field is required for each mount item
fields.help_zh: Bucket 内非空的相对对象目录前缀，每个挂载项必填
fields.name: path

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the mount is read-only. A value of true indicates read-only, and a value of false indicates read and write. If omitted, the default value is false
fields.help_zh: 是否只读挂载。true 表示只读，false 表示可读写；省略时默认为 false
fields.name: read_only

fields.help_en: The list of OSS directory mounts. The total number of items in this list and agenticFsMounts cannot exceed 10. The entire list is replaced during an update. Pass an empty array [] to clear the list
fields.help_zh: OSS 目录挂载列表，与 agenticFsMounts 合计最多 10 项；更新时整体替换本列表，传 [] 清空
fields.name: oss_mounts

fields.help_en: The request header configuration for the current protocol. The key is a non-empty request header name, and the value must be a string
fields.help_zh: 当前协议的请求头配置。键为非空的请求头名称，值必须为字符串
fields.name: headers

fields.help_en: The purpose description of the current API path
fields.help_zh: 当前接口路径的用途说明
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The non-empty API path corresponding to the current protocol
fields.help_zh: 当前协议对应的非空接口路径
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The list of API paths corresponding to the current protocol
fields.help_zh: 当前协议对应的接口路径列表
fields.name: paths

fields.help_en:
The invocation protocol type. Valid values:
agui: AG-UI protocol.
openai-chat-completion: OpenAI Chat Completions compatible protocol.
custom: Custom protocol
fields.help_zh: 调用协议类型。agui：AG-UI 协议；openai-chat-completion：OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容协议；custom：自定义协议
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The list of invocation protocols supported by the agent. Each item contains the protocol type and optional paths and request headers. The entire list is replaced during an update
fields.help_zh: 智能体支持的调用协议列表，每项包含协议类型以及可选的路径和请求头。更新时整体替换该列表
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The ARN of the RAM role used by the agent to access user cloud resources. The role must have permissions to access the cloud resources
fields.help_zh: 智能体访问用户云资源时使用的 RAM 角色 ARN。角色需具备所访问云资源的权限
fields.name: role_arn

fields.help_en:
The compute specification. Valid values:
INTERACTIVE: 1 vCPU and 2 GiB of memory.
STANDARD: 2 vCPUs and 4 GiB of memory.
HEAVY: 4 vCPUs and 8 GiB of memory
fields.help_zh: 计算规格。INTERACTIVE：1 vCPU、2 GiB 内存；STANDARD：2 vCPU、4 GiB 内存；HEAVY：4 vCPU、8 GiB 内存
fields.name: compute_class

fields.help_en: The compute resource configuration for the agent runtime instance
fields.help_zh: 智能体运行实例的计算资源配置
fields.name: compute

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable elastic scaling. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 是否启用弹性扩缩容。省略时默认为 false
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The maximum number of concurrent sessions allowed per instance. Valid values: 1 to 20. Default value: 20
fields.help_zh: 单个实例允许的最大并发会话数，取值为 1～20，省略时默认为 20
fields.name: max_concurrent_sessions_per_sandbox

fields.help_en: The upper limit of instances. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 10. The value cannot be less than the value of minSandboxCount
fields.help_zh: 实例数量上限，取值为 0～100，省略时默认为 10，不能小于 minSandboxCount
fields.name: max_sandbox_count

fields.help_en: The lower limit of instances. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 1. The value cannot be greater than the value of maxSandboxCount
fields.help_zh: 实例数量下限，取值为 0～100，省略时默认为 1，不能大于 maxSandboxCount
fields.name: min_sandbox_count

fields.help_en: The maximum idle time for a session, in seconds. Valid values: 60 to 86400. Default value: 600
fields.help_zh: 会话空闲上限，单位为秒，取值为 60～86400，省略时默认为 600
fields.name: session_ttl_seconds

fields.help_en: The elastic and session configuration. Omitted fields use default values. To retain the original policy during an update, submit the complete hpa object or omit the entire runtime object
fields.help_zh: 弹性与会话配置。省略的字段使用默认值；更新时如需保留原策略，提交完整 hpa，或省略整个 runtime
fields.name: hpa

fields.help_en: The name of the request header for session identification. This field is required when type is set to ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD and must be a valid HTTP request header name. Do not specify this field for other policies
fields.help_zh: 会话标识请求头名称；type=ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD 时必填，须为合法 HTTP 请求头名称；其他策略不填写
fields.name: header_name

fields.help_en:
The session policy type. Valid values:
AFFINITY: Session affinity.
ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD: Associates sessions by using the request header specified in headerName.
ISOLATED_COOKIE: Not recommended for use.
DISABLED: A compatibility option. The response returns AFFINITY
fields.help_zh: 会话策略类型。AFFINITY：会话亲和；ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD：使用 headerName 指定请求头关联会话。ISOLATED_COOKIE 暂不建议使用。DISABLED 为兼容选项，响应返回 AFFINITY
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The session policy configuration. It is used to set the session association method for requests
fields.help_zh: 会话策略配置，用于设置请求的会话关联方式
fields.name: session_policy

fields.help_en: The runtime configuration. Both compute and sessionPolicy must be provided. Omitted fields in hpa use default values
fields.help_zh: 运行配置，必须同时提供 compute 与 sessionPolicy。 hpa 的省略项使用默认值
fields.name: runtime

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to use the image cache. If omitted during creation, the default value is false. You can explicitly set this parameter to true or false. The new contract rejects null and invalid types. Existing compatibility endpoints are processed according to migration agreements
fields.help_zh: 创建时省略默认 false；显式 true/false 设置。新契约拒绝 null 和非法类型；既有兼容入口按迁移约定处理
fields.name: use_image_cache

parameters.help_en: The JSON configuration of the custom code or image agent. You must specify name, artifact, roleArn, and runtime
parameters.help_zh: 自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent的 JSON 配置，必须提供 name、artifact、roleArn 和 runtime
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token passed as a query parameter. This parameter is required when explicitly submitting a customImage or setting container.type to custom, and is optional for ACR image and code package submissions. The token must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), colons (:), and hyphens (-). Reuse the same token for retries of the same submission. If the same token is used with different parameters, the request is rejected
parameters.help_zh: 通过 Query 参数传入的幂等标识。显式提交 customImage 或 container.type=custom 时必填；ACR 镜像与代码包提交可选。长度为 1～128 个字符，允许字母、数字、点、下划线、冒号和连字符；同一提交重试复用，相同标识用于不同参数会被拒绝
parameters.name: client_token

code.description_en: The request result code. The value is SUCCESS if the request is successful
code.description_zh: 请求结果码。成功时为 SUCCESS

data.description_en: The latest submitted configuration and status of the custom code or image agent. A successful response indicates that the request is accepted, but the configuration may not have taken effect yet
data.description_zh: 自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent的最新提交配置及状态。响应成功表示请求已受理，配置可能尚未生效

agentId.description_en: The unique identifier of the custom code or image agent. You can obtain this ID from the response of CreateCustomAgent or ListCustomAgents
agentId.description_zh: 自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent的唯一标识，可从 CreateCustomAgent 或 ListCustomAgents 的响应中获取

agenticFsMounts.description_en: The NAS storage mount configuration. Currently, only the AgenticFS type is supported, which is used to mount file directories in access points to agent runtime instances. This represents the latest submitted NAS mounts

artifact.description_en: The latest submitted deployment artifact configuration, including the service listening port and ACR container image. To check whether the configuration has taken effect, refer to latestVersionStatus

code.description_en: The code package deployment configuration. This parameter is mutually exclusive with container. The code package uses the ZIP or TAR.GZ format. Dependencies must be packaged by the user. The platform does not install dependencies or perform online builds
code.description_zh: 代码包部署配置，与 container 互斥。代码包使用 ZIP 或 TAR.GZ 格式，依赖由用户打包，平台不安装依赖或在线构建

entrypoint.description_en: The startup command for the code package. This parameter is required in code package mode. The working directory is the root directory of the decompressed code, /code, such as python main.py. Quotes and escapes are supported. Environment variables, pipelines, and logical operations are not automatically expanded. For complex commands, use a script in the package
entrypoint.description_zh: 代码包启动命令，代码包模式必填。工作目录为解压后的代码根目录 /code，例如 python main.py。支持引号和转义，不自动展开环境变量、管道或逻辑运算；复杂命令请使用包内脚本

languageRuntime.description_en: The identifier of the code runtime environment for the currently saved configuration. The runtime image uses the saved snapshot. Adding a new version to the directory does not automatically change the existing configuration
languageRuntime.description_zh: 当前已保存配置的代码运行环境标识。运行镜像使用已保存的快照，目录增加新版本不会自动改变现有配置

sourceUri.description_en: The fixed oss:// address of the code package referenced by the currently saved configuration on the platform. This address does not include the signature parameters of the source HTTPS link. You can use this address to reuse an existing code package. To download the content, call GetAgentCodePackageDownloadUrl

logging.description_en: The latest submitted log delivery configuration
logging.description_zh: 最新提交的日志投递配置

sls.description_en: The Simple Log Service (SLS) log delivery destination

logstore.description_en: The name of the SLS Logstore that receives agent logs
logstore.description_zh: 接收智能体日志的 SLS Logstore 名称

project.description_en: The name of the SLS project that receives agent logs
project.description_zh: 接收智能体日志的 SLS Project 名称

name.description_en: The name of the custom code or image agent
name.description_zh: 自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent名称

network.description_en: The network access configuration of the agent. The actual access scope is also limited by the network configuration of the workspace
network.description_zh: 智能体的网络访问配置，实际访问范围还受工作空间网络配置限制

accessInternet.description_en: The Internet access configuration of the agent. If this item is not configured, the agent is allowed to access the Internet, but the access is still limited by the workspace
accessInternet.description_zh: 智能体的互联网访问配置。未配置该项时，智能体侧允许访问，仍受工作空间限制

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether the agent is allowed to access the Internet. The actual access is still limited by the workspace

accessVpc.description_en: The user VPC access configuration of the agent. If this item is not configured, the agent is allowed to access the user VPC, but the access is still limited by the workspace
accessVpc.description_zh: 智能体的用户 VPC 访问配置。未配置该项时，智能体侧允许访问，仍受工作空间限制

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether the agent is allowed to access the user VPC configured for the workspace. The actual access is still limited by the workspace
enabled.description_zh: 智能体侧是否允许访问工作空间配置的用户 VPC，实际访问仍受工作空间限制

observability.description_en: The observability configuration for the high-code agent
observability.description_zh: 高代码 Agent 观测配置

observability.title_en: 高代码 Agent 观测配置
observability.title_zh: 高代码 Agent 观测配置

ossMounts.description_en: The latest submitted list of OSS directory mounts
ossMounts.description_zh: 最新提交的 OSS 目录挂载列表

items.description_zh: 一个 OSS 目录挂载配置项

bucketName.description_en: The name of the mounted OSS bucket
bucketName.description_zh: 挂载的 OSS Bucket 名称
bucketName.title_en: OSS Bucket 名称；每个挂载项必填
bucketName.title_zh: OSS Bucket 名称；每个挂载项必填

mountPath.description_en: The absolute mount path in the container, such as /data/train. Mount targets cannot be duplicated or form parent-child overrides, and must avoid platform reserved directories
mountPath.description_zh: 容器内的绝对挂载路径，例如 /data/train；挂载目标不得重复或形成父子覆盖，并须避开平台保留目录
mountPath.title_en: 容器内 /mnt/oss/ 下的子目录；每个挂载项必填
mountPath.title_zh: 容器内 /mnt/oss/ 下的子目录；每个挂载项必填

path.description_en: The non-empty relative directory prefix in the currently configured bucket
path.description_zh: 当前配置的 Bucket 内非空相对目录前缀
path.title_en: Bucket 内非空对象前缀，例如 datasets/train；不允许根目录或上级目录跳转
path.title_zh: Bucket 内非空对象前缀，例如 datasets/train；不允许根目录或上级目录跳转

readOnly.description_en: Specifies whether the mount is read-only. A value of true indicates read-only. A value of false indicates read and write
readOnly.description_zh: 是否只读挂载。true 表示只读，false 表示可读写

ossMounts.title_en: OSS 挂载列表，与 AgenticFS 合计最多 10 项
ossMounts.title_zh: OSS 挂载列表，与 AgenticFS 合计最多 10 项

protocol.description_en: The list of invocation protocol configurations for the agent
protocol.description_zh: 智能体的调用协议配置列表

items.description_en: An invocation protocol and its path and request header configurations
items.description_zh: 一种调用协议及其路径、请求头配置

additionalProperties.description_en: The string value of the protocol request header
additionalProperties.description_zh: 协议请求头的字符串值

headers.description_en: The request header configuration for the current protocol. The key is the name and the value is a string
headers.description_zh: 当前协议的请求头配置，键为名称，值为字符串

paths.description_en: The list of API paths corresponding to the current protocol
paths.description_zh: 当前协议对应的接口路径列表

items.description_en: An API path and its purpose description
items.description_zh: 一个接口路径及其用途说明

description.description_en: The purpose description of the current API path
description.description_zh: 当前接口路径的用途说明

name.description_en: The interface path corresponding to the current protocol
name.description_zh: 当前协议对应的接口路径

type.description_en:
The invocation protocol type. Valid values:
agui: AG-UI protocol.
openai-chat-completion: OpenAI Chat Completions compatible protocol.
custom: Custom protocol
type.description_zh: 调用协议类型。agui：AG-UI 协议；openai-chat-completion：OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容协议；custom：自定义协议

enumValueTitles.openai-chat-completion: OpenAI 对话补全兼容协议

regionId.description_en: The region ID of the workspace to which the agent belongs
regionId.description_zh: 智能体所属工作空间的地域 ID

roleArn.description_en: The ARN of the RAM role used by the agent to access user cloud resources
roleArn.description_zh: 智能体访问用户云资源时使用的 RAM 角色 ARN

runtime.description_en: The latest committed runtime configuration, including compute specifications, session policy, and elastic policy
runtime.description_zh: 最新提交的运行配置，包括计算规格、会话策略和弹性策略

compute.description_en: The compute resource configuration for the agent runtime instance
compute.description_zh: 智能体运行实例的计算资源配置

computeClass.description_en:
The compute specification. Valid values:
INTERACTIVE: 1 vCPU and 2 GiB of memory.
STANDARD: 2 vCPUs and 4 GiB of memory.
HEAVY: 4 vCPUs and 8 GiB of memory
computeClass.description_zh: 计算规格。INTERACTIVE：1 vCPU、2 GiB 内存；STANDARD：2 vCPU、4 GiB 内存；HEAVY：4 vCPU、8 GiB 内存

enumValueTitles.HEAVY: 高负载型：4 vCPU、8 GiB 内存
enumValueTitles.INTERACTIVE: 交互型：1 vCPU、2 GiB 内存
enumValueTitles.STANDARD: 标准型：2 vCPU、4 GiB 内存

hpa.description_en: The elastic policy configuration of the agent
hpa.description_zh: 智能体的弹性策略配置

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether elastic scaling is enabled in the current configuration
enabled.description_zh: 当前配置是否开启弹性扩缩容

maxConcurrentSessionsPerSandbox.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent sessions per instance in the current configuration
maxConcurrentSessionsPerSandbox.description_zh: 当前配置的单实例最大并发会话数
maxConcurrentSessionsPerSandbox.title_en: 单 Sandbox 最大并发会话数
maxConcurrentSessionsPerSandbox.title_zh: 单 Sandbox 最大并发会话数

maxSandboxCount.description_en: The maximum number of instances in the current configuration
maxSandboxCount.description_zh: 当前配置的实例数量上限

minSandboxCount.description_en: The minimum number of instances in the current configuration
minSandboxCount.description_zh: 当前配置的实例数量下限

sessionTtlSeconds.description_en: The maximum idle time for a session in the current configuration, in seconds
sessionTtlSeconds.description_zh: 当前配置的会话空闲上限，单位为秒

sessionPolicy.description_en: The session policy configuration of the agent
sessionPolicy.description_zh: 智能体的会话策略配置

headerName.description_en: The name of the HTTP request header used by the session policy. This applies to ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD
headerName.description_zh: 会话策略使用的 HTTP 请求头名称，适用于 ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD

type.description_en:
The session policy type. Valid values:
AFFINITY: Session affinity.
ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD: Uses the request header specified by headerName to associate sessions.
ISOLATED_COOKIE is not recommended. The compatible value DISABLED in a request is returned as AFFINITY
type.description_zh: 会话策略类型。AFFINITY：会话亲和；ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD：使用 headerName 指定请求头关联会话。ISOLATED_COOKIE 暂不建议使用。请求中的兼容值 DISABLED 返回为 AFFINITY

enumValueTitles.DISABLED: 兼容选项，响应为会话亲和
enumValueTitles.ISOLATED_COOKIE: Cookie 会话选项（暂不建议使用）
enumValueTitles.ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD: 基于请求头的会话策略

additionalProperties.description_en: The number of instances for the corresponding sandbox phase
additionalProperties.description_zh: 对应运行实例阶段的实例数量

sandboxPhaseCounts.description_en: The number of instances by sandbox phase. Keys include PENDING (creating or initializing), RUNNING (running), HIBERNATING (hibernating), HIBERNATED (hibernated), RESUMING (resuming), TERMINATING (terminating), and FAILED (failed). Only phases that actually occur are returned, and missing keys are treated as 0
sandboxPhaseCounts.description_zh: 按运行实例阶段统计数量。键包括 PENDING（创建或初始化中）、RUNNING（运行中）、HIBERNATING（休眠中）、HIBERNATED（已休眠）、RESUMING（恢复中）、TERMINATING（终止中）和 FAILED（失败）。仅返回实际出现的阶段，缺少的键按 0 理解
sandboxPhaseCounts.title_en: 按 Sandbox Phase 统计自定义智能体的实例数量。当前 Key：PENDING（创建或初始化中）、RUNNING（运行中）、HIBERNATING（休眠中）、HIBERNATED（已休眠）、RESUMING（恢复中）、TERMINATING（销毁中）、FAILED（运行时失败）。仅返回实际出现的 Phase，缺失 Key 按 0 处理。该字段为动态映射，后续可能新增 Key，前端可用 FAILED > 0 判断是否存在异常实例。
sandboxPhaseCounts.title_zh: 按 Sandbox Phase 统计自定义智能体的实例数量。当前 Key：PENDING（创建或初始化中）、RUNNING（运行中）、HIBERNATING（休眠中）、HIBERNATED（已休眠）、RESUMING（恢复中）、TERMINATING（销毁中）、FAILED（运行时失败）。仅返回实际出现的 Phase，缺失 Key 按 0 处理。该字段为动态映射，后续可能新增 Key，前端可用 FAILED > 0 判断是否存在异常实例。

status.description_en: The overall status of the agent. Valid values: Creating (the agent is being created), Running (the agent is running), Failed (the agent failed), Updating (the agent is being updated), Deleting (the agent is being deleted), and Deleted (the agent is deleted). To check the execution progress of the latest configuration, query latestVersionStatus
status.description_zh: 智能体整体状态。Creating：创建中；Running：运行中；Failed：失败；Updating：更新中；Deleting：删除中；Deleted：已删除。最新配置执行进度请查询 latestVersionStatus

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the agent was last updated, in ISO 8601 format. The trailing Z indicates the UTC time zone, and fractional seconds may be included
updatedAt.description_zh: 智能体最近更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式，末尾 Z 表示 UTC 时区，可包含小数秒

useImageCache.description_en: Specifies whether the image cache is enabled

workspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the custom code or image agent belongs
workspaceId.description_zh: 自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent所属的工作空间 ID

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request. A value of 200 indicates success
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求的 HTTP 状态码。成功时为 200

message.description_en: The result message of the request. The value is success if the request is successful
message.description_zh: 本次请求的处理结果说明。成功时为 success

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于定位和排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. A value of true indicates success. A successful creation, update, or deletion does not mean that the background operation is complete
success.description_zh: 请求是否处理成功。true 表示处理成功；创建、更新或删除成功不代表后台操作已经完成
